releaseName: Lokify v1.4.4 – Real Device Google Sign-In, Zero Demo Data & Zero Phone Prompts
releaseNotes:
• Real Google & Email Sign-In: Tapping Continue with Google triggers authentic account selection. Direct email sign-in functions seamlessly without phone numbers.
• Clean Production Experience: Removed all demo alerts, mock phone numbers, demo passwords, and admin credential leaks.
• Zero Phone Prompts: Removed all phone number requests, fields, and displays across all screens.
• Header Refinement: Removed the top right sign-out button and fixed the Locating GPS indicator so it never hangs in infinite loading.
